title: Sparkly lightning bolt
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boltGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE94A'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FFC107'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF9800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='boltEdge' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF9C4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD54F'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Soft glow behind bolt -->
  <polygon points='52,8 34,48 46,48 38,88 68,42 54,42 64,8' fill='#FF8F00' opacity='0.25' transform='translate(1,2)'/>

  <!-- Lightning bolt main shape -->
  <polygon points='52,8 34,48 46,48 38,88 68,42 54,42 64,8' fill='url(#boltGrad)' stroke='url(#boltEdge)' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- Inner highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,16 38,44 47,44 42,76 62,42 53,42 60,16' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Top-left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(22,20)'>
    <polygon points='0,-8 2,-2 8,0 2,2 0,8 -2,2 -8,0 -2,-2' fill='#FFF176'/>
    <polygon points='0,-4 1,-1 4,0 1,1 0,4 -1,1 -4,0 -1,-1' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top-right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(78,14)'>
    <polygon points='0,-7 1.8,-1.8 7,0 1.8,1.8 0,7 -1.8,1.8 -7,0 -1.8,-1.8' fill='#FFEB3B'/>
    <polygon points='0,-3.5 0.9,-0.9 3.5,0 0.9,0.9 0,3.5 -0.9,0.9 -3.5,0 -0.9,-0.9' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Right middle sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(84,50)'>
    <polygon points='0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#FFF59D'/>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top-center small sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(62,9)'>
    <polygon points='0,-4 1,-1 4,0 1,1 0,4 -1,1 -4,0 -1,-1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom-left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(20,68)'>
    <polygon points='0,-7 1.8,-1.8 7,0 1.8,1.8 0,7 -1.8,1.8 -7,0 -1.8,-1.8' fill='#FFD54F'/>
    <polygon points='0,-3.5 0.9,-0.9 3.5,0 0.9,0.9 0,3.5 -0.9,0.9 -3.5,0 -0.9,-0.9' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom-right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(74,78)'>
    <polygon points='0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#FFF176'/>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='2' fill='#FFEB3B'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='62' r='2.2' fill='#FFF59D'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='92' r='1.8' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>
</svg>
